env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 2.1: a Go importer sees an exported const map as a package-level
# variable of its plain type and reads the declared values from it.
cd gouse
logos run .
stdout '^ok small-values$'
stdout '^ok big-values$'
stdout '^ok plain-type$'

-- lib/go.mod --
module example.com/cmexportlib

go 1.27

-- lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

const Small = map[string]int{"b": 2, "a": 1, "c": 3}

const Big = map[int]int{
	7: 49, 2: 4, 11: 121, 5: 25, 9: 81, 1: 1,
	12: 144, 4: 16, 10: 100, 3: 9, 8: 64, 6: 36,
}

-- gouse/go.mod --
module example.com/cmexportgo

go 1.27

require example.com/cmexportlib v0.0.0

replace example.com/cmexportlib => ../lib

-- gouse/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

	lib "example.com/cmexportlib"
)

func fail(msg string) {
	fmt.Println("FAIL " + msg)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func main() {
	var small map[string]int = lib.Small
	var big map[int]int = lib.Big
	if len(small) != 3 || small["a"] != 1 || small["b"] != 2 || small["c"] != 3 {
		fail("small-values")
	}
	if _, ok := small["z"]; ok {
		fail("small-values")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok small-values")
	sum := 0
	for k, v := range big {
		if v != k*k {
			fail("big-values")
		}
		sum += v
	}
	if len(big) != 12 || sum != 650 {
		fail("big-values")
	}
	if _, ok := big[0]; ok {
		fail("big-values")
	}
	if _, ok := big[13]; ok {
		fail("big-values")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok big-values")
	fmt.Println("ok plain-type")
}
